detail.title: Architectural and Methodological Paths to Reasoning Transparency
detail.summary: Foundational reasoning axioms are best challenged through architectural separation (decoupling cognition from control) and the deliberate inclusion of dissonance to prevent premature closure on unverified truths.
detail.reason: Revising the notebook incorporating new source evidence on flow states and system validation to support the foundational assumption challenge project.
